records.jp: うわあああああ！！！
records.en_original: Waaahhh!
records.en: Waaahhh!

records.jp: っと……危なかったぁ
records.en_original: Whoa... That was close.
records.en: Whoa... That was close.

records.jp: ユズ、出てくる場所はちゃんと考えないと。<CR>リーダーくんにぶつかってたら大変だった
records.en_original: Yuzu, you really need to think before making an entrance. It would've been a disaster if you crashed into Leader.
records.en: Yuzu, you really need to think before making an entrance. It would've been a disaster if you crashed into Leader.

records.jp: ぶつからなかったんだからいいでしょ？<CR>……って
records.en_original: But I didn't, so it's fine, right? ...Wait.
records.en: But I didn't, so it's fine, right? ...Wait.

records.jp: あっ、リーダーくん！！
records.en_original: Ah, Leader!
records.en: Ah, Leader!

records.jp: 久しぶり
records.en_original: Long time no see.
records.en: Long time no see.

records.jp: 「ライムさんと一緒にいるのは？」
records.en_original: Who's that with you, Lime?
records.en: Who's that with you, Lime?

records.jp: この子は私の姉、夕月
records.en_original: This is my big sister, Yuzuki.
records.en: This is my big sister, Yuzuki.

records.jp: ユズって呼んで。他のあだ名でも大歓迎！
records.en_original: Call me Yuzu! Or whatever you want, really—I'm totally cool with it!
records.en: Call me Yuzu! Or whatever you want, really—I'm totally cool with it!

records.jp: ユズたち、いつもは二人でコモンの番人をしてるんだよ。<CR>知ってた？
records.en_original: We usually watch over the Common together, just the two of us. Did you know?
records.en: We usually watch over the Common together, just the two of us. Did you know?

records.jp: 知ってるって言われたら驚いてた
records.en_original: If someone told me they already knew, I'd be really surprised.
records.en: If someone told me they already knew, I'd be really surprised.

records.jp: えー、ユズは知ってるって言われたら喜んだけどなー。<CR>なんで知ってるのかワクワクするし
records.en_original: I'd be happy if someone said they knew! I mean, I'd get so excited wondering how they found out!
records.en: I'd be happy if someone said they knew! I mean, I'd get so excited wondering how they found out!

records.jp: 明らかにウソでしょ？
records.en_original: They'd obviously be lying though, right?
records.en: They'd obviously be lying though, right?

records.jp: 会話に割り込める隙がない、どうしたものか……
records.en_original: There's no room for me to jump into the conversation... What should I do?
records.en: There's no room for me to jump into the conversation... What should I do?

records.jp: あ、リーダーさん！<CR>屋上にいましたー
records.en_original: Oh, Leader! I found you—you were on the rooftop.
records.en: Oh, Leader! I found you—you were on the rooftop.

records.jp: いたいた、今日は勉強会の予定なの、忘れてた？
records.en_original: There you are. We were supposed to have a study group today, remember?
records.en: There you are. We were supposed to have a study group today, remember?

records.jp: きららと菜々花も部室で待ってる。<CR>早くリーダーも……ん？
records.en_original: Kirara and Nanaka are waiting for us in the clubroom. Come on, hurry up, Leader... Hm?
records.en: Kirara and Nanaka are waiting for us in the clubroom. Come on, hurry up, Leader... Hm?

records.jp: リーダー、その子たちは？
records.en_original: Leader, who are those girls with you?
records.en: Leader, who are those girls with you?

records.jp: ユーコっていいます！<CR>こっちは妹のラーコ
records.en_original: I'm Yuko! And this is my younger sister, Lako.
records.en: I'm Yuko! And this is my younger sister, Lako.

records.jp: ……それは酷い
records.en_original: ...That's just mean.
records.en: ...That's just mean.

records.jp: リーダーくんとは広島校の時にちょっと接点があって、<CR>顔を出してみたの
records.en_original: I knew Leader a bit back at Hiroshima Academy, so I thought I'd drop by.
records.en: I knew Leader a bit back at Hiroshima Academy, so I thought I'd drop by.

records.jp: 広島校って、リーダーが英雄って呼ばれる<CR>きっかけになったところだよね？
records.en_original: Hiroshima Academy? Isn't that where Leader first got called a hero?
records.en: Hiroshima Academy? Isn't that where Leader first got called a hero?

records.jp: そうそう、英雄くん！
records.en_original: Yup, our very own hero!
records.en: Yup, our very own hero!

records.jp: ユ……ユーコはちょっと黙ってて
records.en_original: Yu... Yuko, maybe you should stop talking for a bit.
records.en: Yu... Yuko, maybe you should stop talking for a bit.

records.jp: そういうことだったんですか。<CR>はじめまして、春日詩帆です
records.en_original: So that's the story. Nice to meet you, I'm Shiho Kasuga.
records.en: So that's the story. Nice to meet you, I'm Shiho Kasuga.

records.jp: 高岡由紀子。<CR>リーダーの昔の知り合いなんて、少し驚いた
records.en_original: I'm Yukiko Takaoka. I'm a bit surprised that you're Leader's old friends.
records.en: I'm Yukiko Takaoka. I'm a bit surprised that you're Leader's old friends.

records.jp: 瀟美岐だ。時間があるなら、リーダーの広島での<CR>活躍を聞かせてもらえないだろうか？
records.en_original: I'm Meiqi Xiao. If you've got time, could you tell us about Leader's adventures in Hiroshima?
records.en: I'm Meiqi Xiao. If you've got time, could you tell us about Leader's adventures in Hiroshima?

records.jp: いったい、どのようにして広島を異灰から<CR>解放したのか、ずっと気になってたからな
records.en_original: I've always been curious how you all managed to liberate Hiroshima from the Testa.
records.en: I've always been curious how you all managed to liberate Hiroshima from the Testa.

records.jp: うん、いーよー。<CR>リーダーくんの武勇伝はいろいろ知ってるからねー
records.en_original: Sure, no problem! I know a lot about Leader's legendary exploits.
records.en: Sure, no problem! I know a lot about Leader's legendary exploits.

records.jp: 「夕月の言っていることは本当？」
records.en_original: Is Yuzuki saying the truth?
records.en: Is Yuzuki saying the truth?

records.jp: 全部じゃないけど、概ねは把握している
records.en_original: We don't know everything, but we know most of it.
records.en: We don't know everything, but we know most of it.

records.jp: 大丈夫、問題のない範囲で話すはずだから。<CR>問題がある話なら、私が止める
records.en_original: It's fine. She'll only share what won't cause any issues. If it's something problematic, I'll stop her.
records.en: It's fine. She'll only share what won't cause any issues. If it's something problematic, I'll stop her.

records.jp: じゃあ、一緒に部室行こう。<CR>ついてきて
records.en_original: All right, let's go to the clubroom together. Follow me.
records.en: All right, let's go to the clubroom together. Follow me.

records.jp: あー、楽しかったー
records.en_original: Ah, that was so much fun!
records.en: Ah, that was so much fun!

records.jp: ごめんなさい、リーダーくん。<CR>突然来てうるさくしてしまって
records.en_original: Sorry for showing up without warning and making a ruckus, Leader.
records.en: Sorry for showing up without warning and making a ruckus, Leader.

records.jp: みんな喜んでたしいいでしょ？
records.en_original: But everyone was happy, so it's fine, right?
records.en: But everyone was happy, so it's fine, right?

records.jp: 「結局二人は何をしに来たんだ？」
records.en_original: So, what did you two come here for, anyway?
records.en: So, what did you two come here for, anyway?

records.jp: はいはーい！<CR>ユズもリーダーくんに会ってみたかったからだよー
records.en_original: I can answer that! I just wanted to meet you, Leader!
records.en: I can answer that! I just wanted to meet you, Leader!

records.jp: あなたが日ノ杜に来た時に、<CR>私だけ会ったことが納得できなかったみたい
records.en_original: When you came to Hinomori, I was the only one who got to meet you, and I guess she couldn't stand that.
records.en: When you came to Hinomori, I was the only one who got to meet you, and I guess she couldn't stand that.

records.jp: それだけじゃないよ
records.en_original: But that's not the only reason.
records.en: But that's not the only reason.

records.jp: わかってる……再確認したかったんでしょ？
records.en_original: I get it... You just wanted to make sure, right?
records.en: I get it... You just wanted to make sure, right?

records.jp: うん……こうしてちゃんと会ってみて、思った
records.en_original: Yeah... Now that we're meeting properly like this, I feel it.
records.en: Yeah... Now that we're meeting properly like this, I feel it.

records.jp: リーダーくんも、詩帆ちゃんたちも、<CR>みんなを助けることができる方法を考えるべきだって
records.en_original: We need to think of a way we can help Leader, Shiho, and everyone else.
records.en: We need to think of a way we can help Leader, Shiho, and everyone else.

records.jp: ……考えてみるだけね
records.en_original: ...I'll give it some thought.
records.en: ...I'll give it some thought.

records.jp: 「意味がわからない。何の話だ？」
records.en_original: I don't get it. What are you talking about?
records.en: I don't get it. What are you talking about?

records.jp: ごめんなさい、詳しくは話せないの
records.en_original: Sorry, we can't really say more.
records.en: Sorry, we can't really say more.

records.jp: でも、今回のリーダーくんとみんななら、<CR>大丈夫じゃないかなって感じるよ
records.en_original: But, you know, with you and everyone else here, I feel like things are going to be all right this time.
records.en: But, you know, with you and everyone else here, I feel like things are going to be all right this time.

records.jp: だから、頑張ってね。<CR>いつでも応援してるからね！
records.en_original: So do your best, okay? I'm always cheering you on!
records.en: So do your best, okay? I'm always cheering you on!
